description: This Java source file defines a class 'MockServerClientExamples' containing example methods demonstrating how to use the MockServer Java client library for creating expectations, verifying requests, retrieving recorded requests, and clearing expectations in a mock server environment.

classes.name: MockServerClientExamples
classes.description: A class providing example methods for interacting with MockServer, including creating expectations, verifying requests, retrieving recorded requests, and clearing expectations.

methods.name: createExpectationMockServerClient
methods.description: Creates a simple expectation on the mock server for a GET request to '/view/cart' with specific cookies and query parameters, responding with a body.

methods.name: createExpectationOverTLSMockServerClient
methods.description: Creates a secure (TLS) expectation similar to the previous, but with secure connection enabled.

methods.name: createExpectationClientAndServer
methods.description: Creates an expectation using the ClientAndServer class instead of MockServerClient.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveAtLeastTwice
methods.description: Verifies that a request with path '/some/path' was received at least twice.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveAtMostTwice
methods.description: Verifies that a request with path '/some/path' was received at most twice.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveExactlyTwice
methods.description: Verifies that a request with path '/some/path' was received exactly twice.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveAtLeastTwiceByOpenAPI
methods.description: Verifies requests matching an OpenAPI spec at least twice.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveExactlyOnceByOpenAPIWithOperation
methods.description: Verifies a specific OpenAPI operation was called exactly once.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveExactlyOnceByExpectationIds
methods.description: Verifies a request by expectation ID was received once.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequence
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests with specific paths.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequenceUsingOpenAPI
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests including OpenAPI-defined operations.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequenceUsingExpectationIds
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests by expectation IDs.

methods.name: retrieveRecordedRequests
methods.description: Retrieves recorded requests matching specific criteria.

methods.name: retrieveRecordedRequestResponses
methods.description: Retrieves recorded requests along with their responses.

methods.name: retrieveRecordedLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves log messages matching specific criteria.

methods.name: clearWithRequestPropertiesMatcher
methods.description: Clears expectations matching a specific request property.

methods.name: clearWithOpenAPIRequestMatcher
methods.description: Clears expectations matching an OpenAPI request.

methods.name: clearWithExpectation
methods.description: Clears expectations by expectation ID.

methods.name: clearRequestAndLogsWithRequestPropertiesMatcher
methods.description: Clears requests and logs matching a request property.

methods.name: clearRequestAndLogsWithOpenAPIRequestMatcher
methods.description: Clears requests and logs matching an OpenAPI request.

methods.name: clearExpectationsWithRequestPropertiesMatcher
methods.description: Clears expectations matching a request property.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the mock server state.

methods.name: bindToAdditionFreePort
methods.description: Binds the mock server to a free port (port 0) and returns the list of bound ports.

methods.name: bindToAdditionalSpecifiedPort
methods.description: Binds the mock server to specified ports (1081, 1082) and returns the list of bound ports.
